metadata.summary: Jitin inquired about ordering lunch from Manhattan Bagel and was presented with several menu options by the BagelBot.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
Yeah. Hi. How are you doing?
I'm doing well, thanks for asking. What can I get for you today? Would you like to place an order?
Yeah. I'm looking to place an order. Can you recommend me something, like, good good? I'm I'm I want to order something in lunch.

We have a variety of delicious options for lunch. One of our popular items is the Grilled Chicken Club, which comes with grilled chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and mayo on a bagel. We also have the Italian Sub, which features ham, salami, and provolone cheese on a sub roll. If you're looking for something a bit lighter, you might enjoy our Chicken Caesar Wrap or our Avocado BLT Sandwich. Which of these options sounds appealing to you, or would you like me to recommend
